notes: Delta is arm_a minus arm_b on identical queries; positive means the first arm scores higher.
A failed arm yields no per-unit evidence: comparisons that need it are preserved as no_units, never treated as zeros.
The bootstrap resamples units; it speaks to sampling noise over the pinned queries, not to new queries.
